a.xlink:title: Delays the current task for the specified number of milliseconds.
Called periodically to send commands to the Nextion LCD display via USART.
Updates current telemetry page by calling its handler if available.
Advances to the next selectable page.
Moves to the previous selectable page.
Sets the current page on the Nextion display.
Appends raw data to the buffer. If the data exceeds the buffer size, no data is appended.
Appends formatted data to the buffer using printf-style formatting. !
Sets the text of a Nextion display object.
Sets the text of a Nextion display object using printf-style formatting.
Sets a value to a specified object on the Nextion display.
Sets the baud rate for the Nextion display.
Sets the brightness of the Nextion display.
Returns whether USART peripheral is currently transmitting data.
Starts a tx using dma, use PHAL_usartTxDmaComplete to ensure the previous transmission is complete.
Clears the buffer by resetting length to 0.
Write a logic value to an output pin.
